subject: Follow-up: Security/Compliance discovery — incident response & BCP evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Reyes <alex.reyes@fintechcorp.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Security/Compliance discovery — incident response & BCP evidence

Hi Alex / Samir —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams have everything in one place: 

Call summary:
- We covered Redwood's deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private) and the controls relevant to FinTechCorp's regulated workloads.
- You requested information on: SOC 2 status and evidence we can share, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, vendor security questionnaire kickoff, and specifics on incident response / breach notification timelines and BCP/DR evidence.

Requests / next steps we discussed:
1) We'll provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a one-page SOC summary (attached).
2) I'm attaching an initial vendor security questionnaire (PDF) — if you can fill this out with your preferred procurement fields or tell us a template, we will prioritize.
3) You asked for our incident response commitments: high-level timelines below and we can provide a redacted IR playbook and runbook excerpts for BCP/DR evidence.

Redwood incident response (operational commitments):
- Initial customer notification: within 24 hours of confirming an impact to customer data or availability.
- Forensic timeline and interim findings: within 72 hours.
- Final incident report & remediation plan: within 30 days (or earlier if mutually agreed).

BCP / DR evidence we can produce on request:
- BCP overview and recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) for critical services.
- Recent DR test summary and date.
- Contact for on-call/incident escalation.

Attachments included: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-2025-redacted.pdf (redacted), FinTechCorp-vendor-questionnaire-initial.pdf

Proposed next steps:
- Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security ops team next week (options: Tue 4/7 10—11am PT, Wed 4/8 2—3pm PT)?
- Marissa (cc) will work with our Security team to pull the IR/BCP artifacts you requested; can you confirm the level of redaction acceptable for SOC2 & pen-test summaries?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Date: 2026-04-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security/Compliance discovery — incident response & BCP evidence

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: we're currently targeting SOC 2 readiness for a new vendor baseline; if you can share Type II redacted that's perfect. Procurement will want to know the last audit period and auditor name.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: GDPR applies; HIPAA is not applicable for our primary product but we will confirm if any ancillary data flows change that.
3) Incident response / breach notification: our policy requires notification to our security team within 72 hours of becoming aware for GDPR incidents; can you confirm Redwood's 24-hour operational commitment is achievable and whether that can be surfaced in contract terms?
4) BCP/DR: provide RTO/RPO info and any recent DR test dates. We will want a summary of test outcomes (pass/fail + duration).

We can meet Tue 4/7 10am PT. Sending calendar invite shortly. For questionnaire: we'll start with the PDF you sent and return it with our comments — target is within 7 business days.

Appreciate the speed — Alex
Alexandra "Alex" Reyes
Sr. InfoSec Manager, FinTechCorp
alex.reyes@fintechcorp.com

Note: forwarded to our procurement/legal (Nina) for review.

2) Please confirm whether Redwood's 24-hour notification commitment is contractual or operational (we prefer contractual language for material incidents). If operational only, we'll ask for an escalation path that is contractually-backed.

3) For the vendor questionnaire, we prefer answers in-line in the PDF (not separate docs). We'll return it with redlines/edits.

If you can confirm the above before Tue's call, that would help speed procurement review.
